No. 55/1/1/79-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA(BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVAAYA )

#/texts/3.label: paragraph
#/texts/3.full_gt_text:
The President, on the advice of the Prime Minister,
has allocated the business of the Government to Ministers
in the manner indicated below:-

#/texts/4.label: paragraph

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text: 2. Shri H.N. Bahuguna, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of Finance;

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: 3. Shri Brahm Perkash, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of Agriculture & Irrigation;

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: 4. Shri Hitendra Desai, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of Commerce & Civil Supplies;

#/texts/8.label: paragraph

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text: 6. Shri Ram Kinkar, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of Works, Housing, Supply and Rehabilitation;

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text: 7. Shri H.R. Khanna, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of Law, Justice & Company Affairs;

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: 8. Shri S.N. Mishra, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of External Affairs;

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text:
9. Shri K. C. Pant, to be Cabinet Minister in charge
of the Ministry of Energy;

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
#/texts/13.full_gt_text:
10. Shri T.A. Pai, to be Cabinet Minister in charge
of the Ministry of Petroleum, Chemicals and
Fertilizers; also, for the present, to be in
charge of the Ministry of Railway;

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text: 11. Shri Biju Patnaik, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of Steel, Mines & Coal;

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text:
12. Shri Mohamed Shafi Qureshi, to be Cabinet Minister
in charge of the Ministry of Labour; 16CA.

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text: 13. Shri Rabi Ray, to be Cabinet Minister in charge of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare;

#/texts/17.label: paragraph
#/texts/17.full_gt_text:
14. Shri K. Brahmananda Reddi, to be Cabinet Minister
in charge of the Ministry of Industry;
